description: One MCP endpoint giving any AI agent 448 market-intelligence tools: SEO, backlinks, paid ads, SERP, app stores, reviews, scraping, LLM mentions.
rules: The Prowl MCP endpoint is https://prowl.chat/mcp — streamable HTTP transport, not stdio
Authenticate with the header Authorization: Bearer prowl_<key>; OAuth 2.1 access tokens start prowl_oat_
MCP tool arguments are FLAT — Prowl tools take no nested argument object
prowl_call_tool takes tool_name and params; the parameter is params, never arguments
prowl_analyze produces a report and NO artifact; PDF, PPTX, video, infographic and audio need a separate prowl_generate_artifact call on the same session_id
prowl_generate_artifact and prowl_export_report require a prior prowl_analyze on the SAME session_id
execution_mode is basic, deep or max; it is a provider-cost ceiling, not a price, and a run is billed what it spent
Pass a stable session_id across consecutive calls to keep the report cache and conversation history scoped to one conversation
One run resolves one country+language; the report's first line states the market and whether it was stated, inferred or assumed
JSON-RPC -32001 is unauthenticated, -32002 rate limited, -32003 authenticated-but-not-allowed (usually an empty wallet), -32603 internal
Rate limit is 120 requests per minute per API key; honour Retry-After on 429
Tool prices are runtime configuration and are deliberately not published in this repository
